financials_interim.notes: Mercantile Investments and Finance PLC (MERC) is a licensed finance company (NBFI); this filing presents a SINGLE set of financial statements for 'the Company' only -- Investment in associates (Rs.1,999,822k) is equity-accounted, not consolidated, and no subsidiaries exist -- so basis=GROUP is entered by this project's convention for single-entity filings (same figures would apply to a COMPANY row, so no duplicate row entered). MERC's fiscal year runs April-March (confirmed by SOFP comparative '31 March 2026'), so 'For 03 months ended 30 June 2026' is genuinely Q1 FY2026/27 with no quarter-vs-cumulative ambiguity. Per NBFI convention: revenue = 'Total operating income' (2,742,337, the filing's own top-line subtotal = net interest income + net fee income + other operating income); operating_profit = 'Operating profit before tax on financial services' (979,926), the company's own subtotal; profit_before_tax = 'Profit before taxation from operations' (713,557), which already includes 'Share of associate company's profit, net of tax' (54,936); tax_expense = 'Income tax expenses' (319,130) -- note this excludes the separate 'Tax on financial services' line (321,305), which is netted off BEFORE profit_before_tax (i.e. embedded in the path from operating_profit to profit_before_tax) rather than after, unlike MBSL/PMB/LOFC where VAT/SSCL-on-financial-services sits alongside income tax below PBT -- flagged as a genuine structural difference in this filing's presentation, not an extraction error. profit_after_tax = 'Profit for the period' (394,427). Revenue (Total operating income) grew 65.2% YoY (2,742,337 vs 1,659,772) -- per the Segments Information note (p.5), this is overwhelmingly driven by the LOANS & ADVANCES segment, whose external operating income rose from Rs.1,513,778k to Rs.3,524,544k (+132.9%, a Rs.2,010,766k absolute increase that alone accounts for ~84% of the Rs.2,393,767k total income increase across all segments); the Finance Lease segment grew a comparatively modest 23.6% (Rs.1,492,844k to Rs.1,845,452k) and Investments grew 13.5% (Rs.166,867k to Rs.189,408k). Impairment charges rose even faster (Rs.64,466k to Rs.282,110k, +337.6%) reflecting the much larger loan book, but PBT still grew 125.2% and PAT grew 95.0% (394,427 vs 202,233) as revenue growth outpaced both impairment and operating-expense growth. Inventories (Rs.355,875k) IS explicitly disclosed as a distinct SOFP line in this filing (unlike CDB/LOFC/MBSL where no such line exists) -- populated here as a deliberate deviation from the usual 'leave inventory blank' NBFI convention, because the company itself presents it as a discrete balance-sheet item (likely repossessed lease/HP stock). trade_receivables/trade_payables left blank -- not disclosed as such; 'Other financial assets'/'Other non financial assets' and 'Other liabilities' are not itemised as trade in nature. current_assets/current_liabilities left blank -- liquidity-ordered SOFP, no current/non-current split. short_term_borrowings = 'Bank overdrafts' (1,352,677); long_term_borrowings = 'Financial liabilities at amortised cost - Debt instruments issued and other borrowings' (43,719,027). 'Deposits due to customers' (64,605,815) and 'Lease liability' (673,885) are deliberately EXCLUDED from borrowings -- deposits are funding not debt, and the lease liability is treated as non-debt per this project's convention for small lease liabilities. shares_in_issue = 634,600,000 (actual ordinary shares in issue at 30 June 2026, per note 4) -- NOTE this differs from the 616,190,000 WEIGHTED-AVERAGE shares used by the company itself to compute both EPS and Net Assets per Share, because the Rights Issue (33,400,000 new shares, raising Rs.1,102.2m) completed and listed only on 4 June 2026, partway through the quarter; cross-check ties to the weighted-average basis: EPS 0.64 = 394,427k/616,190k = 0.6402 (ties), and NAV/share 28.20 = 17,376,721k/616,196k = 28.20 (ties) -- NOT to period-end shares (17,376,721k/634,600k would give 27.38, which does NOT match the disclosed Rs.28.20 NAV/share). This is flagged explicitly since it is exactly the 'shares_in_issue vs disclosed EPS' cross-check the project instructions call for, and the mismatch here has a clear, filing-disclosed cause (note 6, mid-period Rights Issue) rather than being an extraction error. Cash flow statement (p.4) is genuinely quarter-only ('For 03 months ended 30 June'), no cumulative-vs-quarter ambiguity. capex = Purchase of PPE (80,470) + Acquisition of intangible assets (1,934) = 82,404, ties exactly to the segment note's own 'Capital expenditure' figure of 82,404 (p.5).
